A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe the same VLN-PE study. Their main text, Tables 1-7, Figures 1-15, equations, and Appendices A-E are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation benchmarks, controller and lighting experiments, and a 14-episode real-world Unitree Go2 evaluation in Appendix B and Table 7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original simulation experiments and the 14-episode real-world evaluation in Appendix B and Table 7.

M1.justification: Sections 3-4 and Appendix A retain the same platform, RDP architecture and losses, stopping procedure, and improved VLMaps exploration and planning components.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate stair-filtered R2R, GRU-VLN10, and 3DGS-Lab-VLN, with the same robot embodiments, lighting scenarios, and real-world Go2 navigation task.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in corresponding experiments is unchanged, including Seq2Seq, CMA variants, NaVid, VLMaps, and the random policy. The real-world CMA fine-tuning comparison is also retained.

E3.justification: Appendix A.3 changes RDP's explicitly reported total training batch size from 4 to 8 on four GPUs. This is a limited training-setting revision; neither PDF establishes whether experiments were rerun. Other reported protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The controller-engagement, cross-embodiment training, and lighting studies are retained unchanged, as are Appendix C's failure analysis and the supplementary qualitative examples.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Tables 1-7 retain their numerical entries, and the empirical figures and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports RDP's R2R val-unseen SR/SPL as 21.98/16.44 in both versions. The batch-size revision is not accompanied by revised scores.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(12), the VLMaps planning cost function, and metric definitions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning VLN-PE, physical and visual transfer gaps, the RDP baseline, and cross-embodiment training.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving viewpoint height, controller mismatch, RGB sensitivity, rendering artifacts, and stopping failures remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the same egocentric-perception limitation and proposed future extensions.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 revises the documented RDP batch size from 4 to 8 while retaining the hardware, training duration, optimizer, and learning rate. The abstract prints the project URL explicitly, but its hyperlink destination is identical in both PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 65 references and research positioning are retained. Reference [17], NavComposer, gains an arXiv identifier and preprint metadata; this updates an existing citation rather than adding related work.

P1.justification: Limited editorial changes replace the abstract's linked 'here' with the printed URL, expand funding acknowledgments, and complete Reference [17]'s metadata. The section organization and scientific narrative remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5 is reformatted and rasterized, changing its typography and dimensions while retaining the plotted comparisons. Minor text and table reflow occurs, and printed page-number footers disappear. All figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The methods, empirical evidence, analyses, claims, and limitations remain essentially unchanged. The isolated batch-size revision and small reference, link, funding, and presentation edits do not materially change overall quality. The PDFs do not establish that the batch-size amendment reflects rerun experiments or a validated correction.
